node.title: Sparse constant children or one-sided shared-carrier compression
node.statement: For W subset U^2 with dim U=s>=3, dim W=s+1, degrees<K and N-K+1>2(K-1), the bivariate Pluecker product is either nonzero, giving at most2K-2 good rank-one children, or identically zero, forcing W=(delta tensor U) direct_sum Fz with constant delta. Every rank-one good child is constant by equality rigidity. This is an exhaustive geometric dichotomy over the original field, not an original-label payment.
